text_block_list.text:
A box addressed to me from Eishin
Flash's parents
arrives the day after her
debut.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Interwoven in its branches are berries,
dried
flowers, and, on closer inspection,
spices. It's a
beautifully symmetrical and
intricate masterpiece.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Attached to it is a card with the
message,
"Congratulations on debuting"
written in
perfectly balanced Japanese
characters.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I received the same wreath. The message
affixed
to it was different, however.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
"May the joy you felt at your debut
continue
throughout your racing career."
That is the wish
mine is imbued with.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
When I opened the box and smelled the
faint
aroma of spices, I immediately
knew it was made
by my mother's hand.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Yes. My mother has always had a
fondness for
making wreaths.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: This is just a hobby for her?!

text_block_list.text:
That is correct. My parents excel at
many things!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Both are dexterous and quick to learn
whatever
they turn a hand to.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
My mother has extraordinary sense for
wreath
design, as you can see, and my
father is
knowledgeable in many things
outside the realm
of confectionery, as
well.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
In fact, my mother was the one who
designed
almost every piece of furniture
in our house, and
my father was the one
who built them!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
They always shied away from praise,
saying it's
amateur work, but it is truly
gorgeous. I would
love to show you
someday, actually!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: You must really respect your parents.

text_block_list.text: I do... I respect and admire them greatly.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
To me, they are the symbols of what is
right.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Can you elaborate on what you mean?

text_block_list.text:
Both my parents proudly saw through
their own
chosen paths. For my mother,
it was racing, and
for my father, it was
baking.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
"May you accomplish all you want on the
path
you choose." That was the message
written for
me.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I wish to live up to their expectations
and carry
on as they do. However, I lack
the ability to do so
as I am now.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: You don't think you have what it takes?

text_block_list.text:
I don't. I'm still so inexperienced—I can't
hold a
candle to my parents.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Once, when I was a child, I made a
wreath under
my mother's instruction.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
However, mine paled in comparison to
hers, so I
asked her how I could improve.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
"Experience is something you
accumulate over
time," she told me.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
"If you interlace branches the right way
and work
hard to do everything
correctly, all will come
together
beautifully in the end."
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
My mother always created a thorough
plan for
her races—just as she did for her
wreaths—and
carried it through to
perfection.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I still lack the finesse and experience she
has. My
schedule is designed to alleviate
these
deficiencies of mine.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I will see this timetable through to the
end and
become a better, more proper
version of myself...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Then, I can return to Germany with
pride... and
show my parents who I have
become.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It seems her profound admiration for her
parents
is what caused her to be fixated
on doing things
the "right" way.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As she calmly talks about her grand
plan, I can't
help but feel moved
realizing it all stemmed from
her simple
wish of wanting to make her parents

proud.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Let's!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: If I may ask, where is your wreath now?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Good. All looks well.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I placed it next to your door. That space
is in
shade year-round, so there's no
danger of the
wreath losing color.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it. By the way, could we
discuss
my training schedule?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Specifically, I would like to increase my
training
load leading up to the Japanese
Derby.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Learning how much my parents expect of
me has
renewed my determination to
improve further.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I previously said that I didn't want to set
victory
as my goal. However... I wish for
my mother to see
me win the Derby.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, she did
mention how
passionate she was about
the Derby when we first
talked about
her three-year schedule.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Why is the Derby so special to you?

text_block_list.text: I suppose it's because...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
When I was young, my mother showed
me the
German Derby.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
The race left a strong impression on me,
but then
my mother told me something.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
She said that some races overseas, like
the
Japanese Derby, are amazing too,
and how
they're a true spectacle every
single year.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
So, I asked her if I would be amazing if I
ran in the
Japanese Derby.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
She answered with the largest smile that
day,
saying, "You would be super, toll
und klasse,
Flash!"
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
All of those words translate to
"amazing," but I
had never heard my
mother use them in
succession with such
excitement before.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Winning the Derby would surely make
her happy.
That being the case, it would
only be right to win
it.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Making her happy is your dream, huh?

text_block_list.text: I'm unsure if "dream" is the correct word.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
The visions we see while in deep sleep
are also
"dreams." Thus, the word itself is
vague and
intangible.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
To me, bringing my mother joy is not a
dream,
but a reality that I must make
happen.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to go over my training
schedule
again to ensure I'll be able to
win the Derby.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: I'm with you all the way.

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Now, concerning when I
should start...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I've learned a lot today about how
important
Eishin Flash's parents are to
her, and what it
means for her to do
things the "right" way.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
